end.summary:
Practised identifying cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
Recognised cylinders roll and identified a candle as a cylinder.
Initially treated every box as a cube; later distinguished a matchbox as a cuboid using unequal rectangular faces.
Initially thought turning a cone changes its shape name; this was corrected later.
Teach-back was not passed; 2 of 7 attempts were unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised matching solid shapes to familiar objects, including a candle, matchbox, ball and car parts. They used face shape and size to correct the mix-up that every box is a cube. Asha revisited the idea that turning a cone does not change its name, and Aditya accepted this later in the lesson. At home, ask them to find one example of each shape and turn it around while naming it.
